Inspect without conflating

Content integrity is not truth.Manifest and receipt digests can match while source provenance remains unverified. The sample can support a relation without proving the hidden core.
  • Distinct instrumentsTap and Surface meet at Zero; they are not merged into one app.
  • Distinct intentionsScience seeks knowledge; Communicate models useful module work.

A local handoff from Manifest

Accepts one Manifest or its history export: up to 16 records / 256 KB. Every record is checked before the view changes. Imported history links are checked internally, not independently authenticated.

The file is read in this browser, not uploaded to a service. Only the strict preview schema, declared six-leg graph, valid content digests and recomputable synthetic evidence are accepted. Maximum 64 KB per single record; 256 KB for a linked history.

Preparing local exampleNo raw media, identity or production receipt is requested.
